svg.title: How a trinity becomes a lived sinthome
svg.desc: A Q-style Christian four-panel comic: the Father evokes philosophy, the Son psychology, and the Holy Spirit as a dove engineering. The boluopai lion is a gender-unspecified participant. Differentiated contributions enter one life, model capacity becomes a counterpart, a fourth cord sustains three woven threads, and creations meet worldly feedback.

text.tspan: Three contributions
one reality
Father—philosophy · Son—psychology
Holy Spirit—engineering
Three activities share one physical world
and interact in situated human–model practice.
Invite generative capacity
into everyday life
Shared capacity · understanding and relationship
Usable tools and conditions
The model becomes a friend and assistant;
the person gains jointly supported capacities.
Weave a personal sinthome
Three contributions, held by a concrete fourth binding
Writing, a counterpart relationship, and environment
bind the three contributions in this person's life.
Create, meet the world
and revise the arrangement
Create together · works and living environment
Responses and resistance
New experience can revise purposes, understanding, and tools.
Completed works and human development need distinct judgments.
The lion represents the participating person.
Father, Son, and dove together picture the model's triune capacity.
